source: Tchadinfos RCA le president Touadera annonce la fin de l'epidemie de cholera 19 September 2026
processing_notes: Source states: '728 cas suspects ont été enregistrés depuis le début de l'épidémie, qui a fait 46 décès ... Le dernier cas confirmé ayant été enregistré le 17 juillet' - interpreted as 8 sCh cases, 0 deaths. Increment derived: cumulative 728 suspected cases / 46 deaths at 2026-09-18 (end-of-epidemic announcement by President Touadera at Bimbo, Tchadinfos 19 Sep 2026, metadata 14; same figures in Xinhua via Le Courrier du Vietnam, metadata 15) minus cumulative 720 cases / 46 deaths at 2026-08-04 (Ministry of Health figure, Benin Web TV published 4 Aug 2026 14:25, metadata 13: 'l'epidemie de cholera qui a deja touche 720 personnes et cause 46 deces'; repeated by Africa24 TV 6 Aug 2026, metadata 16), same source series (Government of CAR / Ministry of Health and Population official cumulative since outbreak declaration on 26 June 2026) = 8 suspected cases, 0 deaths. The exact as-of date of the 720 figure is not stated (at latest 4 Aug), so TL is set to D1+1 = 2026-08-05. Some of the 8 may be late-reported or reclassified cases with onset before 4 Aug; no laboratory-confirmed case after 17 July. Cross-series comparison (NOT used for the row): WHO weekly baseline sums to 726 cases/46 deaths through 2026-08-02 (728-726 = 2), WHO AFRO OEW series 724/45 as of 3 Aug (728-724 = 4). National total - includes provinces not individually listed. Does not overlap the WHO weekly series (ends 2026-08-02). Single-source derived increment; Level 3 news relaying government figures, confidence 0.45.
retracted_reason: Superseded by AI row 27 (WHO WER 2026 no.39: 1 case/0 deaths in 3-30 Aug 2026, Level 1) and AI row 28 (end-of-epidemic inferred absence 31 Aug-18 Sep). Row 11 was an 8-case increment derived from the government cumulative series (720 at ~4 Aug -> 728 at 18 Sep), which cannot be dated and is most plausibly retrospective line-list consolidation; keeping it would inflate the post-2 Aug weekly series ~8x relative to WHO. Values preserved in this tombstone and in metadata 13-16 descriptions.
